newsitem.title: USA: Valassis offers 18 mln shares -- source.
newsitem.headline: Valassis offers 18 mln shares -- source.

text.p: Valassis Communications Inc did a secondary offering of 18 million shares at $24 per share, a source close to the company said Wednesday.
"All of it was sold," the source said.
A spokeswoman for the sales promotion company said Valassis was still in the "quiet period" and declined comment.
Valassis's stock was among the most active on the New York Stock Exchange, up 13/16 at 24-13/16 on volume of 3.2 million shares.
At the start of June, Valassis said it had filed a form S-3 with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 13 million shares.
All of the shares were to be sold by an affiliate of Consolidated Press Holdings Ltd, a 50 percent shareholder of Valassis, and Valassis would not receive any proceeds, the company said then.
